bio.text: Niki Conforti, an energy consultant from Glen Ellyn, won the Republican primary for Illinois' 6th Congressional District on March 17, 2026, setting up a November 3 rematch with Democratic Rep. Sean Casten.
She was the Republican candidate in the district in 2024, when Casten defeated her.
Her WTTW voter guide entry lists her occupation as energy consultant since 2017.

sources.title: U.S. Rep. Sean Casten defeats challenger Niki Conforti in battle over Illinois' 6th Congressional District
Conforti, Casten, Set For Rematch In 6th Congressional District
